name: @frankledo/receiptnamer
description: Name scanned receipt PDFs by reading the rendered image with a vision-language model (local Ollama or Anthropic API)
author: Frank Ledo <frank@frankledo.com>

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const f='dist/index.js'; let c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'); if(c.startsWith('#!')) c=c.slice(c.indexOf('\n')+1); fs.writeFileSync(f, '#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c); fs.chmodSync(f, '755')"
